author: Amr Hamzawy, Sarah Yerkes, and Kathryn Selfe (Carnegie Endowment for International Peace)
locator: Carnegie Endowment Research Paper (Feb 9, 2026), Sections 'The U.S. Policy Tool Kit', 'Egypt-Israel', 'Jordan-Israel', 'Palestine-Israel', and 'Conclusion'
notes: Comparative mediation analysis across four tracks (Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine), showing why pre-defined final borders, MFO third-party verification, and conditional U.S. inducements sustained the 1979 and 1994 treaties while Oslo's deferred final-status issues, lack of settlement freeze, and unpoliced spoilers led to breakdown.

title: U.S. Peace Mediation in the Middle East: Lessons for the Gaza Peace Plan
